title: 'Vertex Force' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event revealed additional cast, theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and the second promotional video for the Vertex Force original television anime on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, and Tochigi TV at 11:30 p.m. on October 3.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy At All Reveals Mitsuki and Aya Character Visuals
content: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All anime revealed character visuals for Mitsuki and Aya ahead of the show’s January 2027 release date. The announcement was made during Aniplex’s event today.

title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers TV Anime Reveals New Opening Theme Artist, Special Promo Video
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed the new opening theme song artist for the television anime adaptation of Akira Ozaki 's Please Excuse My Younger Brothers ( Uchi no Otōto-domo ga Sumimasen ) manga. Neguse.
author: ANN

title: Vertex Force Original Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists, More Cast in 2nd Promo Video
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a second promotional video and the theme song artists for Vertex Force , an original television anime from Strike Witches and Vividred Operation director Kazuhiro Takamura .
author: ANN

title: Fate/EXTRA Record Game Streams Character Video for Archer
content: Aniplex revealed a new character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Saturday during the Aniplex One Focus livestream event. The video features the character Archer, voiced by Junichi Suwabe .
author: ANN

title: Inherit the Winds Anime's New Video Highlights 5 Characters
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a new promotional video for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ). The video highlights five previously announced voice cast members and their characters.
author: ANN

title: Magical Explorer Reveals Kosuke Takioto Character Trailer Ahead of October Premiere
content: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim anime revealed a a character trailer for the main character, Kosuke Takioto. The anime was previously confirmed to premiere on October 3. Studio WHITE FOX is handling the animation, with Kazuki Ohashi as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary TV Anime Debuts on October 4
content: Rock band FLOW will perform the anime's opening theme song "Unstoppable," while metal band ASTERISM will perform the anime's ending theme song "My Way." Crunchyroll will stream the anime.
author: ANN
